description: Find conversations where one message satisfies all supplied filters. Matching IDs identify relevant members; counts still describe the whole conversation.

after.description: Inclusive receipt/submission time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1–3 fractional digits, then Z or ±HH:mm.

before.description: Exclusive receipt/submission time: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optional 1–3 fractional digits, then Z or ±HH:mm.

cursor.description: Continue with next_cursor from the previous result, keeping the same filters. Stop when next_cursor is null.

from.description: Exact email address in From, case-insensitive; not the SMTP envelope sender.

labels_all.description: Require every listed label. Filter groups combine with AND; empty arrays impose no condition.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_any.description: Require at least one listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

labels_none.description: Exclude messages with any listed label.

items.description: Case-sensitive label, trimmed; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

order.description: Defaults to newest. Relevance requires query; ties use newest first. Threads order by their latest activity.

query.description: Match all words or quoted phrases in subject/body. Case-insensitive keyword search, not semantic similarity; up to 16 terms/phrases.

recipient.description: Exact email address in To/Cc/Bcc where available, case-insensitive.

subject.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of the subject.

name: list_threads

last_activity_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 service timestamp in UTC (Z), with millisecond precision.

matching_message_count.description: Total matching members; may exceed the returned matching IDs.

matching_message_ids.description: Up to 100 matching member IDs, newest first. Present when filters are supplied.

title: Find conversations
